stage_agent_tool_modification.description: Stages the parameters needed to propose a modification to an existing agent tool. This prepares the information for the self-modification review and application process, typically for ActionExecutor. Supports both full function replacement and surgical node replacement.

schema_details.name: stage_agent_tool_modification
schema_details.description: Stages the parameters needed to propose a modification to an existing agent tool. This prepares the information for the self-modification review and application process, typically for ActionExecutor. Supports both full function replacement and surgical node replacement.
parameters: The module path of the tool (e.g., 'ai_assistant.custom_tools.my_tool').
The function name of the tool to modify.
The complete new source code for the modified function, OR the replacement snippet for surgical edits.
Detailed description of the changes made or the reason for modification.
Optional. The ID of the reflection entry that suggested this modification.
Optional. The 'tool_name' for logging/display in ActionExecutor, defaults to function_name.
Optional (Required for surgical). The existing code snippet to match and replace.
returns: A JSON string representing a dictionary containing 'action_type_for_executor': 'PROPOSE_TOOL_MODIFICATION' and 'action_details_for_executor': {details_dict}.
